title: Key Metrics for Local Facebook Ads
takeaway: Focus on click-through rates and cost per lead to measure local ad efficiency.

data.label: Cost per lead (Ad A)
data.evidence: For example, if Ad A costs $5 per lead and Ad B costs $12 per lead, you know Ad A is more efficient for your budget.

data.label: Cost per lead (Ad B)
data.evidence: For example, if Ad A costs $5 per lead and Ad B costs $12 per lead, you know A is more efficient for your budget.

data.label: Click-through rates
data.evidence: Look at click-through rates. This tells you if your ad creative and message are interesting enough to stop someone scrolling.

hero_stat.label: Most Efficient Ad Cost Per Lead

narration: To make decisions about ad performance, you must track metrics like click-through rates and cost per lead. Comparing these numbers helps determine which ad is more efficient for your budget.
